meta.description: Site-wide yardsticks (file 20 §3, §5.2): formula over figure ids, recomputed value, and the value published in file 20.
meta.conventions: Decimal points and no thousands separators in JSON numbers; French formatting (comma decimal, narrow no-break space) is applied at render time. EUR bn = billions of euros, current prices. Every share says % of GDP or % of total public expenditure.

parameters.label_en: Monthly income of the reference household (design choice)

parameters.notes: File 20 §3.2: scale factor = EUR 36,000 / EUR 1,562.5 bn of revenue. Chip [[yard:household_monthly_income_eur]] resolves to this parameter: chips resolve against yardsticks[] first, then parameters[] (validate.py checks it). Mention: illustratif (editorial choice, not a statistic).

parameters.label_en: Illustrative cut used in the macro-feedback explainer
parameters.label_fr: Baisse illustrative utilisée dans l'explication du bouclage macroéconomique

conversions.formulas_note: days_of_spending = EUR bn / one_day_spending_eur_bn; pct_of_deficit = EUR bn / deficit_eur_bn x 100; eur_per_inhabitant = EUR bn x 1000 / population_m; pct_of_total_spending = EUR bn / te_eur_bn x 100; pct_of_gdp = EUR bn / gdp_eur_bn x 100. 2026-2027 amounts are set against 2025 denominators: orders of magnitude (file 16 header).
